text: みずの　ある　ばしょで　つかうと　ポケモンが　つれる。

structure.jp: みずの　ある　ばしょで
structure.en: in a place where there is water

structure.jp: ポケモンが　つれる。

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: みずの　ある　ばしょ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed before a thing, tells you which thing. Inside such a phrase の can stand in for が. みずの　ある　ばしょ = 'a place that has water'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever the first thing happens, the next follows. つかうと = 'if you use it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to the え-row plus る means 'can do'; the thing you can catch takes が. ポケモンが　つれる = 'Pokémon can be fished up'.
